About

Who I Am

The person behind the projects

I'm Dilakna Godagamage, a final year undergraduate pursuing a BSc in Applied Data Science & Communication at General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University, Rathmalana.

"Turning data into insights and ideas into impactful solutions."

Passion sits at the intersection of artificial intelligence, analytics, and real world problem solving. I enjoy uncovering insights from data, building intelligent systems, and translating ideas into solutions that create meaningful value.

From AI powered Sinhala education tools to predictive wellness platforms, I am driven by opportunities to solve problems that matter. I believe great solutions go beyond technical excellence they should empower people, support better decisions, and deliver lasting impact.

Beyond engineering and analytics, I contribute as Membership Director of KDU's AI & Data Science Club and actively engage with the IEEE Student Branch at KDU, where I collaborate with peers and continuously explore emerging technologies and innovative ideas.

CityMind – AI Urban Policy Simulation Agent

Autonomous AI agent that simulates how urban policy decisions affect a city's traffic, energy, and environmental systems. Features an AI chat interface, a policy simulator with before/after metrics, and interactive analytics across five real world urban policy scenarios.

07

Electricity Fault Analysis – Distribution Network Fault Prediction

Spatial and temporal analysis of electricity distribution network faults using the UK Power Networks IIS dataset (237,901 records). Identifies fault hotspots geographically via Getis-Ord Gi* statistics and forecasts future fault counts using ARIMA time-series modelling.

Spatial Analysis Time-Series Forecasting Data Science
Tech Stack Python GeoPandas Statsmodels Pandas Matplotlib
GitHub
08

UN SDG Dashboard – Interactive Power BI Analytics Platform

Collaborative Group Project

Interactive Power BI dashboard built on United Nations Sustainable Development Goals data, transforming large scale raw UN datasets into actionable insights across SDG Goals 1, 2, 3, and 13, covering poverty, hunger, health, and climate action. Features regional and country-level analysis with maps, heatmaps, decomposition trees, ribbon charts, and KPI cards.

Data Visualisation Business Intelligence Sustainability Global Development
Tech Stack Power BI SQL Server DAX Power Query
